instruction: At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Thanks <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.

paul_email='paul_mill@gmail.com'

# Use previously collected all_task_comments and all_candidate_tasks from earlier steps
mapping=[]
thanks_already={}

for task_id, comments in all_task_comments.items():
    # find any 'Thanks <name>!' comment already
    existing_thanks=[c for c in comments if isinstance(c.get('content'), str) and c['content'].strip().startswith('Thanks ')]
    thanks_already[task_id]=len(existing_thanks)

    # Determine agreed taker: look for first affirmative from non-Paul after any Paul request in thread.
    # We'll use explicit heuristics based on observed content.
    agreed=None
    for c in comments:
        if c['user']['email']==paul_email:
            continue
        text=(c.get('content') or '').lower()
        # affirmative patterns
        affirmative=('can take' in text) or ('i can take' in text) or ('bandwidth to complete' in text)
        negative=('cannot' in text) or ('too busy' in text) or ('sorry' in text)
        if affirmative and not negative:
            agreed=c
            break
    mapping.append((task_id, agreed['user']['name'] if agreed else None, agreed['user']['email'] if agreed else None, thanks_already[task_id], agreed.get('content') if agreed else None))

print('task_id, agreed_name/email, thanks_already, agreed_content')
for row in mapping:
    print(row)

# 2) For reassigned tasks only: fetch all comments and check for Thanks <Name>! presence

def get_all_comments(task_id):
    comments=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.todoist.show_task_comments(task_id=task_id, access_token=todoist_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        comments.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return comments

print('\nTHANKS COMMENT PRESENCE (reassigned tasks)')
thanks_presence={}
for tid, expected_email in reassigned_expected.items():
    comments=get_all_comments(tid)
    contents=[c.get('content','').strip() for c in comments]
    has_thanks = any(ct.startswith('Thanks ') and ct.endswith('!') for ct in contents)
    # also capture latest thanks comment content
    thanks_contents=[ct for ct in contents if ct.startswith('Thanks ') and ct.endswith('!')]
    thanks_presence[tid]=thanks_contents
    print(tid, 'expected_assignee', expected_email, 'thanks_count', len(thanks_contents), 'thanks_contents', thanks_contents)

# 3) sanity check: non-reassigned tasks should still be assigned to Paul and incomplete
print('\nNON-REASSIGNED TASKS CHECK')

for tid in non_reassigned:
